notDefects.description: Main moved past the merge base (184897acc1, #2419): changelog entries are now fragment files, and the old [Unreleased] heading is now 'Before changelog fragments'. Main's own rule moves an open pull request's old-heading entries into fragments at its next merge of main. GitHub reports this pull request mergeable, so no merge is due. No behaviour and no gate change.

The comment 'the title is a few words' is loose: an ask's or decision block's question is the title, and it can hold up to 2,000 characters. The cost is one to_tsvector per word, so this is wording only.
